title: Chapter 524
text:
Boom!

Nagojin's spaceship collided with a Dark-star battleship that was almost a hundred meters long. The interior of the two spaceships shook violently, and the hatch in front of Nagojin opened. He was directly exposed to the universe, and the Godora combat suit on his body activated to provide him with a life support system.

Then, golden flames ignited on Nagojin's body and exploded behind him. Like the tail flame of a propeller, Nagojin seemed to have turned into a golden meteor and slammed into the outer armor of the Dark-star battleship.

The difference in size between a single person and a battleship that was almost a hundred meters long was extremely huge. It was like an ant colliding with an elephant.

However, the strength of this punch left a deep dent in the outer armor of the Dark-star battleship!

The next second, Nagojin punched a hole in the Dark-star battleship, and a large number of metal fragments shot out. Nagojin charged into the battleship with golden flames wrapped around him.

Boom boom boom!

This Dark-star battleship began to explode continuously. Nagojin charged forward and disintegrated this Dark-star battleship from the inside. Not a single Dark-star warrior on the ship could stop him. It was as if he had entered a no-man's land, and all the equipment and devices were smashed into pieces. Under the chain reaction, more and more parts were paralyzed.

Very quickly, Nagojin charged out again, jumped into the spaceship, and left this battleship in search of his next target.

Behind him, the battleship that was riddled with holes suddenly exploded, turning into fireworks in the universe!

In space battles, powerful Supers were usually the vanguard, engaging in side battles and attacking the enemy's spaceship from the inside. After all, tearing the spaceship apart with bare hands was too dangerous, and the efficiency was far less than destroying the interior.

…

Godora's remaining troops retreated according to Barette's orders, preparing to rendezvous with the main force. Nakapu sensed Barette's radical thoughts and quickly reacted, splitting the assault team once again. Most of the assault ships chased after the remaining troops to prevent the command ship from being besieged.

There were only thirty assault ships left to attack Blue Star. Although Black Star had yet to make a move, Nakapu had estimated Black Star's strength based on the records and believed that these forces were more than enough.

Without the protection of Godora's fleet, Blue Star was like a delicate young lady. Thirty Dark-star assault spaceships entered the atmosphere and fired at the surface.

Boom! Boom!

Beams of green ion cannons rained down from the sky like thunderbolts.

These assault ships were not attacking randomly. Instead, they were firing at the Six Nations' capitals and shelters. Their goal was to destroy these locations and destroy the disaster relief efforts.

Han Xiao had already ordered more than a dozen mercenary spaceships to guard these areas. At this time, they were activating their shields to block the lightning-like green ion cannons.

Boom!

Explosions resounded through the clouds, and the shields of the spaceships flickered incessantly. The strength of the shields was gradually weakening.

The players in the shelters could not see the spaceships in the sky, but they could see the green ion cannons raining down endlessly. It was like a series of thunderbolts raining down continuously. It was like a scene of a natural disaster.

This scene shocked many of the players, and they began to discuss among themselves.

"Are these spaceships attacking us?"

"F * ck, the mission progress is decreasing. Is it because of the attack?"

"If not for these spaceships blocking the attack, the shelters would have been destroyed!"

The refugees in the Six Nations' capitals and shelters were not as confident as the players. Every beam from the ion cannons rained down on the spaceships' shields, and countless refugees were scared out of their wits. Their faces were as white as paper, and they hurriedly covered their heads and fled. The situation was chaotic.

Han Xiao had already boarded the Blacklight Stealth, and the officers of the mercenary group had also gathered on the ship. Their faces were solemn. Godora's fleet had gone out to chase after the enemy, and they could only rely on them to deal with the remaining enemy spaceships.

If he had known that Godora was not reliable, Han Xiao would not have placed his hopes on them. Thus, he was not too disappointed and shook his head helplessly.

"In this day and age, no one can be relied on. We have to take matters into our own hands!"

Sylvia observed the situation and hurriedly said, "There are thirty small Dark-star spaceships. Based on their current firepower, the shields can only last for a few more minutes. We have to get rid of these enemies before then. If not, the shelters will be severely damaged."

Han Xiao nodded. Currently, he only had a single spaceship that could deal with the enemy, which was the Blacklight Stealth. If he wanted to get rid of the enemy quickly, it would be best to engage in a boarding battle and let his officers enter the spaceships to wreak havoc. However, the firepower of the thirty spaceships was rather ferocious. If they got close, even with the Blacklight Stealth, they would still be in danger.

Luckily, he had chosen the Virtual Technology path. If the hardware was not strong enough, he could make up for it with the software.

"Ginette, you will control the spaceship. Sylvia, you will be his assistant."

In order to maintain the combat power of his officers, Han Xiao decided to let someone else pilot the spaceship.

He turned around and opened the control panel beside him. A three-dimensional virtual interface appeared before his eyes. His fingers danced quickly, and he quickly entered a huge amount of data. The data flowed like a waterfall, and he was able to invade the artificial intelligence of the enemy spaceships through the virtual network. His current class was proficient in this aspect, and his skill bonuses were extremely high.

Virtual Mechanics all had data transmitters, and they did not need to connect to the artificial intelligence of the enemy spaceships. As long as they were within the range of the transmitters, they could directly connect to the target's system.

"Risda, help me break the firewall!" Han Xiao said as he operated. This should have been Philip's job, but Risda's efficiency far exceeded Philip's, so his help was much greater.

While Han Xiao was invading the artificial intelligence, the Blacklight Stealth quickly took off. With the help of its powerful engine, the spaceship quickly flew high into the sky and circled around the thirty Dark-star spaceships while firing continuously.

Bang bang bang!

Laser beams hit the shields of the spaceships one after another, but they were unable to break through.

These assault spaceships also fired a few shots at this black spaceship, but they could not do anything to the extremely well-equipped BlackLight Stealth. Seeing that there was only one spaceship on Han Xiao's side, and since they would not be able to penetrate their shield, this assault team did not bother with the BlackLight Stealth that was flying around like a fly and focused on firing at the ground.

The Six Nations looked at the battle in the sky through the satellite, and the upper echelons were extremely nervous.

Godora was not reliable, and Blue Star's last line of defense was only left with Black Star. However, from the looks of it, they were also unable to stop the enemy. The underground fortress where the upper echelons of the Six Nations were hiding started to fill with an atmosphere of despair.

Right at this moment, the shield of one of the spaceships flickered a few times before suddenly disappearing. The laser beam of the Blacklight Stealth directly hit the spaceship, instantly piercing through its outer armor and causing a violent explosion.

Bang!

Flames soared into the sky, and black smoke billowed. This spaceship lost control, and its tail swayed, crashing into its companions beside it. The Dark-star members in the two spaceships fell onto the ground.

"It hit!"

The upper echelons of the Six Nations were suddenly energized!

On the Blacklight Stealth, the virtual image in front of Han Xiao had changed, turning into a 3D projection of a Dark-star spaceship. It was the spaceship that had been successfully infiltrated.

Han Xiao was controlling the projection, and the effects would be directly reflected back to the spaceship's main body. He had turned off the spaceship's shield generator earlier.

"Done."

Undergoing Level 2 authentication … authentication passed!
